name: Industrial Scrap Shredder
textures: single baked 1024x1024 PBR atlas embedded in GLB
physics: Roblox GLB import does not encode Anchored. Static placements must set Anchored=true.
reason: Hard-surface rebuild replaces the box-heavy source with modeled hopper plates, cutter shafts, bearing housings, gearboxes, industrial motors, service panels, conduit, and safety hardware; final static export is one mesh for Roblox stability and performance.
runtime: Loaded with AssetService:LoadAssetAsync; sanitized; every BasePart forced Anchored=true before parenting.
source_geometry: 13,216 triangle detailed Blender source; optimized to 4,800 triangles for Roblox presentation
